name: What is the typical process for designing and installing an outdoor fire feature?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and installing an outdoor fire feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process for an outdoor fire feature begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, aesthetic preferences, and how you intend to use the space. Following this, we develop detailed CAD-supported layouts and material selections, ensuring the fire feature harmonizes with your overall outdoor living design. The construction phase involves proper foundation work, gas line installation if applicable, and finishing with masonry or stone. Permitting coordination is a critical step that we manage, ensuring all local codes in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex are met before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, CAD design, material selection, construction with proper utility installation, and full permit coordination by AKN Design Group.
